name: GitHub Actions Self-Hosted Runner 2.338 (Ubuntu 24.04)
description: Self-hosted GitHub Actions runner that re-registers itself. No Docker.

GITHUB_URL.description: Required: replace with your repository URL (https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}) or organization URL (https://github.com/{org}).

RUNNER_TOKEN.description: Required: a registration token (repo Settings > Actions > Runners > New runner; valid 1 h) or a PAT that may manage self-hosted runners.

RUNNER_LABELS.description: Extra labels, comma-separated, for runs-on. self-hosted, Linux and X64 are always added.

RUNNER_NAME.description: Optional runner name (letters, digits, . _ -). Empty: a generated railway-xxxxxx name, kept on the volume.

RUNNER_GROUP.description: Optional runner group for organization runners. Empty: the Default group.

RUNNER_EPHEMERAL.description: true: a fresh registration for every job (needs a PAT). false: one registration kept on the volume.

RUNNER_SUDO.description: Jobs may use passwordless sudo (apt-get etc.), as on GitHub-hosted runners. false removes sudo.

RUNNER_DISABLE_UPDATE.description: true: the runner never updates itself. GitHub stops sending jobs to outdated runners after a while.

APT_PACKAGES.description: Optional Ubuntu packages (space-separated) installed at every start, e.g. 'postgresql-client libpq-dev'.

TZ.description: Time zone for jobs, e.g. Europe/Istanbul.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between stop signal and kill on redeploy, so the runner can report a cancelled job to GitHub.

PORT.description: Port of the internal /healthz endpoint for Railway's healthcheck. Jobs do not see it.
